research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Astranis is engaged in developing multi-antenna systems for non-terrestrial communications, utilizing reception-side beamforming algorithms to align signals from non-terrestrial stations and generate downlink data streams. Their research also covers satellites using software-defined radio systems, with geostationary satellites employing multiple antennas to provide adjustable spot beams for terrestrial coverage. Additionally, they focus on adjustable payloads for small geostationary communication satellites, enabling flexible communication services.

overview_description.description: Astranis develops small communications satellites designed for geostationary and other high Earth orbits. The company manufactures software-defined satellites used for broadband connectivity, government communications, navigation resilience, and space-based infrastructure applications. Its MicroGEO platform is built to provide dedicated satellite capacity for telecommunications providers, enterprises, and public sector organizations serving remote or underserved regions. Astranis also develops satellite systems with onboard propulsion, radiation-hardened electronics, and configurable bandwidth management technologies for mission flexibility. The company operates across spacecraft design, satellite manufacturing, launch coordination, and in-orbit operations through integrated engineering and testing capabilities. Its satellite network solutions support internet connectivity, defense communications, and resilient positioning and navigation services for commercial and government customers.

product.name: MicroGEO
product.description: Small, radiation-hardened geostationary satellites that provide dedicated broadband capacity for communications operators, enterprises, governments, and regional connectivity programs.

product.description: Dedicated satellite bandwidth and managed connectivity delivered through Astranis spacecraft and ground infrastructure, from MHz capacity leases to end-to-end Mbps services.

product.name: UtilitySat
product.description: A maneuverable multi-mission commercial GEO satellite for broadband, technology demonstrations, bridge capacity, and disaster recovery missions lasting up to approximately one year.

product.name: Omega
product.description: A planned MicroGEO broadband communications system providing dedicated, uncontended satellite bandwidth from a small geostationary spacecraft.

product.name: Nexus
product.description: A planned small MEO satellite platform for resilient positioning, navigation, and timing signals that can supplement GPS against jamming, spoofing, and physical attacks.

product.name: High-Orbit Government Mission Solutions
product.description: Design, production, deployment, and operation of small high-orbit spacecraft for military communications, resilient GPS, science, and other government missions.
